scripts.//build:desktop: Build ONLY the desktop BACKEND binary -> desktop/src-tauri/target/release/johnnyone-desktop. No cache: wipes dist/host-app + .angular/cache and skips the Nx cache, so NO stale Ionic/Angular assets get embedded.
scripts.//desktop: Build (no cache) AND launch the desktop backend against the live worker (johnnyone.ethan-353.workers.dev). Frees :7788 first, then runs in the BACKGROUND (nohup) and returns the prompt; logs go to /tmp/johnnyone-desktop.log. Stop it with: lsof -ti:7788 | xargs kill. Override identity with JOHNNYONE_USER_ID / JOHNNYONE_TENANT_ID env vars.
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && { lsof -ti:7788 | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}" JOHNNYONE_WORKER_URL=https://johnnyone.ethan-353.workers.dev JOHNNYONE_TENANT_ID="${JOHNNYONE_TENANT_ID:-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001}" JOHNNYONE_USER_ID="${JOHNNYONE_USER_ID:-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002}" nohup ./desktop/src-tauri/target/release/johnnyone-desktop > /tmp/johnnyone-desktop.log 2>&1 & echo "johnnyone-desktop launched in background -> log: /tmp/johnnyone-desktop.log (stop: lsof -ti:7788 | xargs kill)"; }
scripts.//deploy:web: Deploy BOTH hosted Cloudflare surfaces (prod): the worker (johnnyone.ethan-353.workers.dev) and the web client (johnnyone.pages.dev). Builds web fresh (no nx cache) so no stale bundle is uploaded.
scripts.deploy:web: nx build web --skip-nx-cache && lokal cf worker deploy --env prod && lokal cf pages deploy --env prod
